project_metadata.design_philosophy: Decoupled capability extension via independent modules (Plugins, Handlers, Engines, Knowledge)

memory_architecture.enabled_capability: Context persistence across conversations (e.g., '前回の続きやって')

Handler.scope: Intent routing, initial parsing, UI wrapper mapping

Engine.scope: Core logic processing, code generation, technical execution

chat_infrastructure.reason: Core routing stack (routes_chat, chat_service, chat_orchestrator) is firmly established.

inspector.reason: Basic framework exists via inspectors folder, but fine-grained role separation can be expanded.

handler.reason: Rich set of functional handlers (HTML, GitHub, Database, Design) is already implemented.

orchestrator.reason: Handler priority selection and conflict resolution logic are operational.

memory.reason: .ai_memory module is deeply structured to capture system states and dependency graphs.

rag.reason: ChromaDB integration and KnowledgeRouter are present for semantic fetching.

engine.reason: HTML engine is clear, but expansion into other domains/languages is the next frontier.

plugin_system.reason: PluginManager is coded, but dynamic auto-loading via plugin.json and uniform interfaces are still evolving.

knowledge_expansion.impact: Drastically increases the precision and quality of LLM outputs by supplying standardized domain logic.

plugin_automation.impact: Achieves true plug-and-play modularity without modifying the core orchestrator paths.

key_takeaway: The system has successfully transitioned from a standard single-agent chat setup to a highly decoupled, scalable AI Platform. Future extensions should rely entirely on adding Plugins, Handlers, Engines, and Knowledge assets rather than altering the core infrastructure.
